sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: LobeHub (formerly LobeChat) is a workspace for AI agents. You chat with a built-in agent or your own, give them skills, memory and tools, connect 40+ model providers, and add them to team chats like Slack, Discord and Telegram.
sixtySeconds.problem: Most AI chat apps are single-user and forget everything. LobeHub lets agents take on tasks, work in parallel, keep memories and live in the chat tools your team already uses, either in LobeHub Cloud or on your own servers.
whoFor: Teams that want AI agents in Slack, Discord or Telegram
People who want one interface for many model providers
Self-hosters who want to keep their data
Builders publishing agents, MCP servers and skills
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a polished, full-featured agent workspace you can self-host with Docker Compose. Its community license limits distributing modified versions commercially.
requirements: Docker and Docker Compose (Linux, macOS, or Windows via WSL 2)
API keys for the model providers you use

overview: LobeHub is an agent workspace with a built-in agent, Lobe AI, that can chat, code, research and write. You can create your own agents with a system role, model, skills, connectors, web search and memory, and group several into an agent team that works sequentially, in parallel or as a debate.

Agents can take tasks and run them once or on a schedule, write long documents in Pages, answer from a resource library, and bring in external coding agents such as Claude Code or Codex. Channels connect your agents as bots on Discord, Slack, Telegram and other messengers, and a GitHub integration tracks their pull requests.

A marketplace on lobehub.com lists community agents, MCP servers and skills in the SKILL.md format. You can use LobeHub Cloud, apps for web, desktop and mobile, or self-host it with Docker Compose, which starts PostgreSQL, Redis, file storage, SearXNG search and the agent gateway.
